title: Validation of Instruments Used for Assessment of Dysphagia in Patients With Esophageal Cancer
brief_summary: This study validates 3 well known dysphagia scores for dysphagia due to malignancies of the oesophagus and gastro-oesophageal junction and to the Swedish language.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Cancer in the gastro-esophageal junction or in the esophagus
* Dysphagia
* Ability to fill in the questionnaires
* Written acceptance of the informed consent

Exclusion Criteria:

* Not for-filling inclusion criteria
* No consent
study_population: Patients with cancer in the oesophagus and as Controls, healthy volunteers.
